phrases.text: This is this week's Fortnite Item Shop! The biggest bundles, every new drop, and every OG that came back.
Seven days of the shop, from November 10th to November 16th, straight from Epic's own Item Shop data.
Let's get into it!
First, the biggest new bundle of the week.
The Mega Man Bundle! Mega Man, Mega Man X and Zero, plus Rush as a sidekick. 10 items.
Listed at 7,300 V-Bucks, it sold for 3,800.
It went live on November 11th and was in the shop until November 15th, so if you missed it, it's gone for now.
Now, the new stuff. These all went live this week.
On November 10th, the Masters of the Universe Bundle. He-Man, Skeletor and She-Ra, 13 items for 3,600 V-Bucks, listed at 6,700.
That one was in the shop until November 13th.
On November 11th, J Balvin, with the J Balvin Bundle for 2,400 and the Jurassic J Bundle for 2,500. Both were in until November 15th.
On November 12th, Marvel. The Black Cat Bundle for 2,300, and the Spider-Man Zero Bundle for 1,800.
On November 13th, the Lil Uzi Vert Bundle. 12 items for 3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 7,100.
And this one stays a while, until December 12th.
Also on November 13th, the Jason Bundle, for 2,500 V-Bucks, until November 15th.
And on November 14th, the PIRATE D. SPEEDY Bundle, for 1,800 V-Bucks, listed at 2,700. It's in the shop until November 20th.
Two more captains landed in the shop on their own.
On November 14th, Buggy, with his coat and knives, for 1,600 V-Bucks. He stays until December 5th.
And on November 15th, Cap'n Hatsune Miku. The full set is 2,200 V-Bucks, listed at 4,100, with 6 items, until December 14th.
If you're grabbing any of these, use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
A few more bundles showed up during the week.
On November 12th, the Escape Artists Bundle, with 37 items for 1,800 V-Bucks. That's the most items in one bundle this week.
On November 10th, the Grim Medicine Bundle, with Scourge and Plague, for 2,200 V-Bucks, listed at 4,600.
And on November 11th, the Archetype Bundle, for 1,800.
Add it all up, and 24 new bundles went live this week.
And a big batch landed in today's shop.
The Gotham City Summer Bundle, with Beach Bod Batman and Coastal Catwoman. 3,000 V-Bucks, listed at 6,900.
High Tide Harley and Chlorophyll Ivy, for 2,300.
The Hatsune Miku Bundle, for 3,200, listed at 5,200.
And the Shohei Ohtani Bundle, with Shohei Ohtani and Samurai Shohei, for 2,800 V-Bucks, listed at 6,100.
All four are in the shop until November 20th.
Plus Candywing's Glitch Locker Bundle, with the Glitch outfit and 6 more items, for 2,800, until November 18th.
Now, the OG check. These Chapter 1 outfits were all in the shop this week.
Snorkel Ops, from Chapter 1, Season 2. That's the oldest one this week.
Radiant Striker, from Season 3, and Sleuth and Bandolier, from Season 4.
Overtaker, Archetype and Moniker, from Season 5. Overtaker was in the shop all seven days.
Tender Defender, Arachne and Flapjackie, from Season 6.
Firewalker and Deep Sea Destroyer, from Season 7, and Signature Sniper, from Season 9.
And some bundles are sticking around for weeks.
The One Piece Bundle, 4,000 V-Bucks, and the Straw Hats Bundle, 3,200, are both in the shop until December 5th.
And the A$AP Rocky Bundle is still 3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 8,800, until December 6th.
Some big ones also left the shop this week.
The Star Wars Samurai Bundle was in the shop until November 12th.
So was the Golden King Bundle, with Ascendant Midas.
And the Cyber Infiltration Pack was in until November 11th.
And one is leaving fast. The Katalina Bundle came in today and is only in the shop until tomorrow, November 17th.
1,600 V-Bucks, listed at 2,500.
Quick recap.
Biggest bundle: Mega Man. Staying the longest: Cap'n Hatsune Miku, until December 14th, and the Lil Uzi Vert Bundle, until December 12th.
New today: Gotham City Summer, Hatsune Miku and Shohei Ohtani. 24 new bundles in seven days, and 13 Chapter 1 OGs in the shop.
Which bundle did you grab this week? Tell me in the comments!
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
